steps.h3: Pipes in Walls, Floors and Ceilings
steps.body: Corroded galvanized pipe, copper pinholes and failed fittings.
Leaks between the curb shutoff and the house, found with listening and tracing gear.
Toilets, supply lines, water heaters and washer hoses.
When old pipe is failing everywhere, we replace it instead of patching leak after leak.

blocks.intro: About 1 in 5 Elgin homes was built before 1940, and that changes where leaks start.

items.body: Homes in the older neighborhoods may still have galvanized steel supply lines. They rust from the inside, and leaks start at the threaded joints, often in several places.
A century of remodels can leave a patchwork of pipe types inside the walls. The transitions between them are common leak points.
In newer west side homes, a slow leak from a supply line or water heater can soak a finished basement before anyone notices.
A pipe that split in January often leaks only after it thaws. See [burst pipe repair](/elgin/burst-pipe-repair).

items.q: How can I tell if I have a hidden leak?
items.preview: Shut off all water and watch the meter.
items.answer: Turn off every fixture and appliance that uses water and watch the meter. If it moves, there's a leak.

items.q: Can you find a leak without tearing out walls?
items.preview: Usually we pinpoint it first, so only a small opening is needed.
items.answer: Usually. We use moisture meters and listening equipment to find the spot, then open only that area.

items.q: When should galvanized pipe be replaced?
items.preview: When it leaks, rusts or loses pressure.
items.answer: When you see rusty water, low pressure or leaks at the joints. At that point, patching becomes a cycle, and repiping ends it.

items.q: Is the leak in my yard my responsibility?
items.preview: Between the curb shutoff and the house, usually yes.
items.answer: The water line from the curb shutoff to your home is usually the homeowner's. Leaks on the city side of that shutoff are usually the city's. We'll help you figure out which side it's on.

items.q: How much does leak repair cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the leak's location and the pipe. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is, the pipe material and how we reach it. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
